or [[Sweet Pea]] |growth = 7 days |season = [[Summer]] |sellprice = {{Price|55}} |gPrice = Not Sold |jPrice = Not Sold |tPrice = {{Tprice|55}} |source = crafting |recipe = [[File:Foraging Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Foraging#Foraging Skill|Foraging]] Level 4 |ingredients = {{Name|Spice Berry|1}}{{Name|Grape|1}}{{Name|Sweet Pea|1}} |recipename = [[Crafting#Seeds|Wild Seeds (Su)]] |produces = 10 Summer Seeds per craft }} '''Summer Seeds''' are a type of [[Crafting#Seeds|Crafted]] seed. The crafting recipe is labeled "Wild Seeds (Su)", but when crafted, the result is "Summer Seeds." Mature plants yield, at random, a [[Grape]], [[Spice Berry]], or [[Sweet Pea]]. Summer Seeds are one of the season-specific crafted wild seeds, along with [[Spring Seeds]], [[Fall Seeds]], and [[Winter Seeds]] that produce crops normally found as [[Foraging|forage]]. While Farming Skill normally increases the chance to grow a quality crop, Foraging Skill increases the chance to grow a quality crop from Summer Seeds. Choosing the [[Skills#Foraging|Botanist profession]] will ensure iridium-quality crops grown from Summer Seeds. Crows do not attack crops grown from Summer Seeds, so the use of [[Scarecrow]]s is unnecessary. ==Sources== *[[Crafting]] (each recipe produces 10 Summer Seeds) *Placing a [[Spice Berry]] in a [[Seed Maker]] (yield: 1-3 Summer Seeds) *Completing the {{Bundle|Summer Forage||y}} (reward: 30 Summer Seeds) *[[Traveling Cart]] (price{{Tprice|55}}) *[[Desert Trader]] on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]] in exchange for 2 [[Fall Seeds]] *[[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|Treasure rooms]] in the Skull Cavern (5-20 each) ==Crops Harvested== Each Summer Seed has an equal chance of yielding one of any of the [[crops]] shown below. {| class="wikitable roundedborder" !Item !Description !Source |- |{{Name|Grape}} |{{Description|Grape}} |[[Foraging#Summer|Summer Foraging]] • Summer Seeds • [[Farming]] |- |{{Name|Spice Berry}} |{{Description|Spice Berry}} |[[Foraging#Summer|Summer Foraging]] • Summer Seeds |- |{{Name|Sweet Pea}} |{{Description|Sweet Pea}} |[[Foraging#Summer|Summer Foraging]] • Summer Seeds |- |} ==Stages== {| class="wikitable roundedborder" style="text-align:center;" !Stage 1 !Stage 2 !Harvest |- |[[File:Wild Seeds Stage 1.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Wild Seeds Stage 2.png|center|link=]] |[[File:Wild Seeds Stage 3.png|center|link=]] |- |3 Days |4 Days |Total: 7 Days |- |} ==Crop Growth Calendar== {{#lst:Crop Growth Calendars|Wild Seeds}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |dislike=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Leo,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus }} ==Recipes== {|class="wikitable" |- !Image !Name !Description !Ingredients !Recipe Source !Sell Price |- |[[File:Tea Sapling.png|center]] |[[Tea Sapling]] |{{Description|Tea Sapling}} |[[Crafting#Seeds|Wild Seeds (any)]] (2){{Name|Fiber|5}}{{Name|Wood|5}} |Mail the day after [[Caroline]]'s 2-heart event |{{Price|250}} |- |} ==Profitability== Summer seeds are a profitable recipe. A craft of Summer seeds yields 10 seeds worth {{Price|550}} total, while a set of iridium ingredients for Summer Seeds only sells for {{Price|420}} ({{Price|436}} with the [[Farming#Farming Skill|Tiller Profession]]). ==Gallery== [[Crafting#Seeds|Wild Seeds]] from any season may appear similar to dead crops during Stage 2 of growth.
